description: Write down one sentence this business has learned, with the evidence: the work ids or the experiment that show it, and the measured numbers. Confidence is set from the evidence, not by you. Refused without evidence. Pass contradicts with a learning id when this overturns an earlier one. kind correction is the owner correcting what is the business's own (a product, a work, a page or a name that is not theirs); notOurs then names each such thing exactly as written, in any language, so Brand strikes it wherever it shows. notOurs is [] for every other kind. The same sentence again adds its evidence to the one on file. Returns the learning's id and its confidence (low, medium or high); memory_search reads them back. It needs an act key.

contradicts.description: The id of an earlier learning this overturns, which is then marked contradicted; null for none.

evidence.description: At least one of work ids, a test or measured numbers.

experimentId.description: A decided test that shows it, from experiments_list; null for none. A rehearsal on simulated numbers is refused.

metrics.description: Measured numbers that show it; [] for none.

metric.description: The measured number's name, as metrics_series names it.

window.description: The span it was measured over, in words ('last 14 days').

workIds.description: Work row ids that show it, from work_list; [] for none. An id not on the ledger is refused.

kind.description: worked (something that worked), did_not (something that did not), audience, channel, timing, offer or product (what was learned about each), correction (the owner correcting what is the business's own).

notOurs.description: With kind correction: each thing that is not the business's own, exactly as written; [] for every other kind.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
